discourse.title: The inner yajna
discourse.excerpt: Any act that is performed as a dedication to Godhead is a yajna. ... The yajna is an exercise in renunciation; it should not emerge off and on, and then be submerged. The spirit of renunciation must be evident in every single act throughout one's life.
discourse.theme: Every act dedicated to God is a yajna; the real sacrifice is within.

reflection: I can't perform grand rituals — does my small life count as worship? Swami says yes: even reverential prostration before mother, father, and preceptor is a yajna. Your real sacrifice is not ghee in a fire — it is the buffalo of power-hunger and the cat of slyness offered on the altar of the mind. Do today's work as an offering to Him, and the whole day becomes a yajna.

video.title: Don't sacrifice your body. Sacrifice your attachment to body | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Mar 11, 1994

seva_nudge: Do one chore at home today as a silent offering — no credit, no announcement.
